Cycle-1 Medium (0022 grant) is resolved. 0022 (new on this branch; absent from origin/main, so not in published 1.5.0) now runs REVOKE UPDATE on outbox.event_attempts from stynx_app. It then grants UPDATE only on the columns result, error, completed_at, provider, protocol, request_bytes, request_sha256, request_headers, response_bytes, response_sha256, response_status and evidence_state. A BEFORE UPDATE trigger outbox.guard_app_attempt_completion (SECURITY INVOKER, pinned search_path) raises 42501 unless OLD.result='CLAIMED' AND OLD.completed_at IS NULL AND NEW.result IN ('SENT','ERROR') AND NEW.completed_at IS NOT NULL, with tenant_id, event_id, attempt_ordinal, legacy_message_id and legacy_state unchanged.

The trigger's current_user='stynx_app' predicate is sound. packages/data/src/database.ts:285 asserts current_user==='stynx_app' for every app transaction, so the app path cannot run under an inheriting login role that would bypass the guard.

Legacy cutover rows are inserted with result 'LEGACY_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE' (outbox.service.ts:272), and legacy error rows are inserted already completed (outbox.service.ts:917). Both fall outside the only permitted app transition and are therefore immutable to stynx_app.
